dataset.name: Human Callosum MRI-PLI-Histology
downloaded_components: MRI DW-SE data and diffusion-tensor outputs
PLI FOM_HSV, In_plane, Retardance and Transmittance

derived_package.mri_orientation_operation: transpose x/y, then flip rows for display convention
derived_package.pli_operation: resize official Retardance/In_plane/FOM_HSV to 96 x 128 for a teaching grid
derived_package.paired_status: same official preview specimen; display-level coarse correspondence, not official registration or pixel-level ground truth

simplified_model.name: StandardScaler + Ridge(alpha=3.0) + Gaussian smoothing(sigma=1.0)
simplified_model.target: official ODBB PLI Retardance resampled to the teaching grid
simplified_model.holdout: 5 x 5 spatial blocks; one block pattern held out
simplified_model.interpretation: coarse structure proxy only; the coordinates preserve broad layout and are not cell-level evidence

independent_ihc_example.description: human brain neuropathology specimen stained for GFAP; used only to explain IHC appearance, not as paired model target

paper_output_only.use: advanced result/output review only; excluded from the official-data teaching package and simple-model fit

active_teaching_input.experience: ODBB official MRI/PLI preview derived package
active_teaching_input.advanced: ODBB official MRI/PLI preview derived package plus separate output_review assets
